name: docs-architect
description: PRD, context, onboarding, reference, and guide skills for documentation across a project's whole lifecycle. Split by source-of-truth and refresh trigger rather than by stack, so a polyglot repo gets one cross-cutting trace instead of four drifting per-stack documents -- and so specification-first documents (docs-prd, written before the code) and dictionary-derived documents (docs-reference, generated after deployment) are never mistaken for each other. Every claim is traceable to a file; a check that could not run reports NOT RUN rather than a silent pass.
